about: Sourced ways to save time, shown on the app's timeline step. Every entry needs a source in data/sources/index.json (no source, no path). UNCONFIRMED entries were read only on a mirror or a secondary source and say so.

paths.title: Hold the city to 60 days
paths.text: Once your SB 9 duplex application is complete, the city has 60 days to approve or deny it. If it misses the deadline, the application is deemed approved.

paths.title: Hold the city to 60 days
paths.text: Once your ADU application is complete, the city has 60 days to approve or deny it.
paths.caveat: The rule that a late ADU decision counts as approved was read only on a mirror site, not yet on leginfo.

paths.title: Ask for a third-party plan check
paths.text: For 1 to 10 units with no floor above 40 feet: if the city expects plan check to take more than 30 days, or hasn't finished in 30 days, you may hire a private professional to check the plans. The city then has 14 days to issue the permit or say in writing what to fix, or the permit is deemed approved.
paths.caveat: Statute text read in a City of Dixon handout, not yet on leginfo. The date it took effect is not checked.
